summary: Existing not_comparable review still holds. GEO deposits only per-sample Salmon/HTSeq counts (GSE282067_RAW.tar) with no author DE table. The paper's only Treg HFHS-vs-SD result is Source Data Fig. 3f: 19 selected genes with a ratio of DESeq2-normalised counts, no P/FDR, from the pilot pooled Foxp3-GFP BALB/c cohort (one n=9 pool per arm, GSM8635148 vs GSM8635150). Revision-era Supplementary Fig. 4 shows activated conventional T cells and brain Tregs-vs-Tconv as images only, not the registered hypothalamic BL/6 Treg HFHSD-vs-SD contrast (GSM8635178-84, GSM8635186). No comparison meets author-concordance-v2 (different cohort, 19 < 30 genes, incompatible effect definition), so no metrics were computed and no ledger change is proposed. The 2026 Author Correction concerns Fig. 7f only.
